name: create_node_safe
title: create_node_safe
description: Adds a node to the scene currently open in the editor. Every property is checked against the target class before anything is instantiated, so a typo in a property name or a wrong value type fails with a precise error instead of a half-built node. The new node's owner is set to the scene root, which is what makes it persist when the scene is saved.

type.description: Engine class to instantiate, e.g. 'CharacterBody2D'. Required unless 'instance_scene' is given.

instance_scene.description: Instantiate this packed scene instead of a bare class. Mutually exclusive with 'type'.

parent.description: Path of the parent node relative to the scene root ('.' is the root). Must not be inside an instanced sub-scene.

name.description: Name for the new node. Defaults to the class name. May not contain . : @ / " %

auto_rename.description: If the name is taken, append a number instead of failing. Set false to make collisions an error.

properties.description: Property values to apply before the node enters the tree. Values are coerced to the property's declared type: numbers for int/float, [x, y] or {"x":..,"y":..} for vectors, '#rrggbb' or {"r":..} for colors, a res:// path for resources.

index.description: Position among the parent's children. -1 appends.

groups.description: Groups to add the node to (persistently).

unique_name_in_owner.description: Mark the node %-accessible from scripts in this scene.

dry_run.description: Run every validation and report what would happen without touching the scene.

path.description: Path of the new node relative to the scene root.

checkpoint.description: Short git SHA of the checkpoint created for this edit, when checkpointing is on.

errors.no_open_scene: No scene is open in the editor.
errors.parent_not_found: The 'parent' path does not resolve in the open scene.
errors.parent_not_editable: The parent belongs to an instanced sub-scene.
errors.unknown_type: 'type' is not a class in this Godot build.
errors.not_a_node: 'type' exists but is not a Node subclass.
errors.invalid_name: The requested name contains characters Godot forbids.
errors.name_conflict: A sibling already uses that name and auto_rename is false.
errors.invalid_properties: One or more properties were unknown or of the wrong type; details.errors lists each one, with did_you_mean suggestions for typos. Nothing was created.
